in_hebrew.name: חֶפְזָא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Hepza in Hebrew has a meaning of 'open, free'. It may be derived from the Hebrew word 'חפז' (chafatz), which means 'to open, to loosen, or to unbind'. The name Hepza could symbolize freedom, release from bondage, or the opening of new opportunities.

in_greek.name: HEPZOΣ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Hepza in Greek is transliterated as Hepzos. The Greek meaning of the name is 'opener'. It could be derived from the Greek word 'αἵρεω' (hairéō), which means 'to take, to lift, or to raise'. The name Hepza in Greek may symbolize the one who opens or uncovers, or the one who lifts or raises.

in_latin.name: HEPZA
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Hepza in Latin is transliterated as Hepza. The Latin meaning of the name is 'opener'. It could be derived from the Latin word 'aperire', which means 'to open'. The name Hepza in Latin may symbolize the one who opens or uncovers, or the one who reveals or discloses.
